message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout, and I was surprisingly prepared this time! I grabbed my trusty flashlight and some power banks I had stashed away, and in no time, we were lighting up the living room with lanterns and keeping our phones charged. It felt great to finally be the one with a plan, instead of scrambling for matches or candles like in the past. Who knew being ready could feel so good? What's your go-to strategy for staying comfy when the lights go out?
